status: SOURCE-MODEL PREDICTIONS; NOT MEASURED OR EMPIRICALLY CALIBRATED
axes_and_units: logical x=read, y=phase, z=slice; s/mm^2; columns bxx byy bzz bxy bxz byz
method: Complete mapped PPL gradient waveform integrated analytically with dwfse.btensor; instantaneous RF centres/sign changes; ss-MGOT carrier/conjugate branch with smallest echo endpoint, longitudinal interval retained. RF latency=3 us and gradient latency=embedded rfdelay. Representative first imaging shot; all mode2 leading volume trains and actual phase rewinder retained.
interpretation: PBS polarity/axis comparisons test relative calibration and cross-term hypotheses. Absolute b calibration requires an independent reference diffusivity and measured temperature; fixed-brain diffusivity is not an absolute b reference. No empirical z-axis correction is assumed. These predictions do not describe mixed FSE pathways.

A.purpose: Load/compile, low-b E1 diagnostic, tissue/PBS high-b baseline

BMatrixWarnings: Source model only: instantaneous RF primary pathway, assumed RF latency 3 us, gradient delay=rfdelay; mixed FSE pathways and measured gradient calibration are not modelled.

BMatrixEcho is the echo containing the k-space centre (centric: 1; reverse-centric: ETL; linear: ETL/2+1), represented by the first imaging shot; shot-dependent phase-encode b terms are not a volume average.
